caption: The drawing depicts a single spoon positioned diagonally from the bottom right to the upper left within a rectangular border. The spoon is rendered in shades of gray and appears to be made of metal, as suggested by the variations in shading along its handle and bowl. The drawing is done on an off-white or slightly yellowed paper, with visible discolorations and stains in some areas, particularly at the corners. There is a dark shadow cast by the spoon, extending downward and to the right, indicating a light source from the upper left. The bottom right corner of the paper features a handwritten signature that reads “Frank Nelson.” The background is otherwise empty, creating a stark contrast between the spoon, its shadow, and the surrounding space.
title: Silver Teaspoon
